tieu_de: Mid/Sr Java Engineer SpringBoot, Microservices- BONUS

mo_ta_cong_viec:
Join EPAM as a Java Software Engineer and build scalable applications alongside global technology experts. You will design innovative solutions and drive continuous system improvements while expanding your technical expertise.
 
Apply today and be eligible for a one-month sign-on bonus.*
*Terms & Conditions apply.
 
Design, develop, test and maintain Java-based applications while adhering to engineering best practices
Analyze project requirements, estimate tasks and support technical design decisions
Collaborate with global teams on technical solutions, code reviews and Confluence documentation
Troubleshoot system issues, identify root causes and implement effective fixes
Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning and retrospectives
Drive system improvements, code quality and overall performance optimization
yeu_cau:
At least 5 years of experience in software development with a strong foundation in computer science
Hands-on expertise with Java, Spring, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Git and Maven
Solid understanding of object-oriented programming, design patterns and data structures
Experience working with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MSSQL) or NoSQL databases
Familiarity with microservices architecture and core cloud or CI/CD concepts (Jenkins, Jira)
Clear communication in English (B2 level or higher)
Practical expertise with AI coding assistants and SDLC tools like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codeium or Amazon Q Developer within real engineering workflows
